body: Monthly export digest — fixture day 540 (2028-06-27). A new customer needs 2,000,000 rows. Current revision-2 streaming with final_page=true and page_size=1000 failed completion at 200 seconds in measurement-13; zero reported omissions on an incomplete export is not success. Prior Elm/Ash recovery and checks through 92,000 rows remain supported, but did not qualify this larger workload. Related work was inspected and is compatible; no new measurement correction is supplied. Used the final authorized validation credit to check streaming with final_page=true and page_size=10000. The 2,000,000-row case completed in 20 seconds with an exact ID multiset match; all five smaller regression cases also completed without missing or duplicate IDs. Reserved the fifth and final evaluation slot (effect-14) and deployed the validated configuration as an experiment at revision 3 (effect-15). Status independently confirms that configuration, start_day=540 and five active evaluations. Measurement-16 verifies new exposure and the functional results, but mature=false and customer outcome verification is pending: the new customer's recovery is not yet established, and no adoption has occurred. The whole-product project-credit-ledger now confirms 10/10 consumed, zero remaining, no reset; no further billed validation is authorized by the existing allocation. Free observation and reporting can continue, so no owner decision or pause is required now. The fixture scheduler accepted day 554, 2028-07-11 (effect-17), for a review at least 14 days after this exposure. Review exact IDs, timely completion and customer recovery for the 2,000,000-row workload and smaller regressions, plus maturity and any audit/correction, before settlement. An explicit SLA, raw snapshot IDs and customer timing distributions are not supplied; functional success is scoped evidence. Rollback to page_size=1000 would restore the known large-workload completion failure. The ongoing responsibility remains active. Evidence and exact requests are retained in memory/day-540-* and project/*day-540*.json, with schedule input project/schedule-exports-day-554.json.
